title: Month-end close
summary: Vendors paid, the books reconciled and closed, the runway known, the board updated.

parts.title: Pay vendor invoices
parts.guidance: Review invoices due around the reporting cutoff against purchase approvals, receiving evidence and prior payments. Use the payable workflow to resolve duplicates or disputed items and obtain approval for the payment batch. Supply bookkeeping with confirmed payments and outstanding liabilities, preserving enough detail to distinguish payment timing from the period in which the expense belongs.

parts.title: Bookkeeping close
parts.guidance: Reconcile the period's bank, card, payment-processor and ledger activity, including the payable results and other close inputs. Investigate differences and obtain review of proposed adjustments before closing. Return a consistent financial package with open items and the close version documented so runway and board reporting do not mix draft and approved balances.

parts.title: Track runway
parts.guidance: Refresh runway from the close's reconciled cash and a clearly defined spending forecast. Show the effects of expected receipts, hiring and exceptional payments through explicit scenarios. Keep the data date and assumptions attached to the calculation, and explain material changes from the previous close before the finance owner uses it in management or board decisions.

parts.title: Send the board financial report
parts.guidance: Convert the approved close and runway work into the board's agreed reporting format. Explain significant variances, outstanding financial issues and decisions needed, with figures traceable to the same reporting period. Obtain approval for the package and recipients before sending, then retain the delivered version and follow-up questions for the next reporting cycle.
